_purpose: Every JUDGMENT call in Layer 2 (things a human or source-code — not a mechanical rule — decided): story splits, priority, scope in/out, how a PENDING item was resolved, spec-vs-code policy. Converts silent judgment into an owned, queryable record.
_why: A mechanical run can assemble schema + traceability on its own (G1/G2 gate that). It must NOT silently pick a side on a judgment call. This ledger is the HALT-and-flag surface: an autonomous run stops on any open human decision instead of guessing.

type_vocab.split: re-decompose a story into QA-internal units
type_vocab.pending-resolution: how a PENDING clarification was answered (PM round OR source code)
type_vocab.spec-correction: spec deliberately differs from the Jira/PM wording
type_vocab.policy: cross-cutting rule for how the spec itself is authored

status_vocab.resolved-by-code: answered from source code with a file ref — settled (no PM round needed)
status_vocab.proposed: QA proposed it; awaiting human confirmation — OPEN
status_vocab.pending-human: explicitly needs a named owner to sign off — OPEN

_halt_rule: AUTONOMOUS L2 must HALT if any decision of type {split, priority, scope, policy} has status {proposed, pending-human}, OR any {pending-resolution} lacks a source_ref. {confirmed} and {resolved-by-code with source_ref} are settled and do not block. Enforced by checks/decision_ledger.py --autonomous.

decisions.decision: Split Jira story PDT-3562 (UC1) into QA-INTERNAL units UC1a (video / recorded player component) and UC1b ('Live' player component). Jira stays ONE ticket — no new key.
decisions.rationale: Separate player components on every platform (GAP-04); web-Live reveal-controls overlay is net-new. Resolves INVEST 'small'. AC-01/02/03/05 behaviour is identical across the two — the split is about a distinct component to build + test per platform, not different behaviour.

decisions.decision: Boundary skip-back that lands on 0:00 PRESERVES the prior play/pause state (playing → continues from 0:00; paused → stays paused). It is NOT a forced pause.
decisions.rationale: Jira AC-03 reads 'the video is in a paused state' which is wrong — play/pause changes only via explicit user action (BR-10). A clamp is position-only.
decisions._note: Jira wording not yet aligned → FU-5 (PM to update Jira). Our spec is the source of truth for testing.

decisions.decision: Seek / ±10s skip controls exist ONLY on video / recorded LS — never on an active Live stream. Consolidated into BR-01.
decisions.rationale: PM ACs silently contradicted each other (pause overlay 'shows seek' vs 'Live has no seek'). One BR removes the contradiction at the source.

decisions.decision: App backgrounded during an active overlay/timer → adopt the OS default (Option 1): iOS pauses on background and does not auto-resume; the wall-clock 1s timer has already elapsed, so a playing overlay is dismissed and a paused overlay persists. No stale mid-countdown overlay.
decisions.rationale: Answered from source rather than a PM round — spec = build-as-is.

decisions.decision: Network drops while paused → 'Reconnecting' auto-retry indicator (no manual button); stream stays paused through the drop→recover cycle (no auto-resume); on user resume → snap to live edge (seekToLiveEdge()+play()).
decisions.rationale: Answered from iOS + web source instead of a PM round.

decisions.decision: MoSCoW: UC1a = Must, UC1b = Must, UC2 = Should, UC3 = Could (sprint order 1,1,2,3).
decisions.rationale: QA-effort + dependency ordering; UC3 is the real descope lever ('nice-to-have' ≠ cheap, still scored High).
decisions._open: PM must confirm MoSCoW before sprint commit — this is part of the team sign-off package.

decisions.decision: The LIVE badge / viewer-count live-update stays as-is — updating it is OUT of scope for this feature (a separate enhancement).
decisions.rationale: PM ACs scope the pause/resume behaviour only; badge/count is orthogonal.
decisions._open: Part of the scope-boundary doc awaiting PM + Dev lead + QA sign-off.

decisions.decision: web-mobile is excluded from Live pause/resume scope (pause of an active Live stream is not offered on mobile web).
decisions.rationale: Standing platform boundary (BR-02), not a new decision — documented in the platform table, not awaiting sign-off.

decisions.decision: The spec is authored to the TARGET behaviour. Where current code differs — web overlay 3s→1s (BR-03), web rapid-tap debounce→accumulate (BR-08), web-Live reveal overlay net-new — those are DEV DELTAS / build tasks, not spec gaps. The spec does NOT bend to match incomplete code.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed code-incomplete does not block the process; surfacing deltas is a WIN of authoring spec before code.
